meta.title: RepoChan — Local-first creative production for repository mascots
meta.description: RepoChan turns a git repository into a living mascot persona, tracked visual assets, and an editable project homepage.

hero.headline: Turn a repository into a mascot.
hero.body: RepoChan is a creative production pipeline that turns git repos into living character personas, tracked visual assets, and editable project homepages.
hero.describe: このリポジトリに魂を。

pipeline.heading: Each role produces a durable artifact.
pipeline.body: RepoChan does not hide creative work in chat history. Every stage writes a schema-validated file under .repochan so the next role can inspect, revise, and continue from it.

steps.name: Analyst
steps.body: Scans repository structure, README signals, tech stack, git profile, and content inventory.

steps.name: Creative Writer
steps.body: Turns repository identity into a living mascot, color palette, role prompt, and brand direction.

steps.name: Art Director
steps.body: Creates structured asset commissions with intent, deliverables, references, and acceptance criteria.

steps.name: Painter
steps.body: Generates images with reference assets and records exact prompts, files, and metadata.

steps.name: Page Designer
steps.body: Fills an editable Astro template with i18n copy, theme tokens, and tracked assets.

protocol.heading: Creative history that survives the session.
protocol.body: The .repochan directory is the project's creative ledger: analysis, persona, orders, versions, reviews, and pages are plain files that can be inspected, tested, and migrated.

features.heading: From git repo to living mascot — every step tracked.

items.title: Analyst
items.body: Scans repository structure, README signals, tech stack, git profile, and content inventory.

items.title: Persona Design
items.body: Turns repository identity into a living mascot with color palette, role prompt, and brand direction.

items.title: Art Direction
items.body: Creates structured asset commissions with intent, deliverables, references, and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Tracked Assets
items.body: Every image is traceable to an order, version, prompt, and file. Nothing lives only in chat history.

items.title: Editable Output
items.body: Generates a real Astro project you can keep editing — not a screenshot, not a black box.

items.title: Local-First
items.body: All protocol state in .repochan/ on disk. Version, diff, git-blame your creative work.

gallery.heading: The page exists because the mascot assets exist.
gallery.body: This dogfood page uses the generated Chan foundation sheet, hero banner, chibi stickers, pattern textures, poster, and icon grid. Each visual is still traceable to an order, version, prompt, and file.

workflow.heading: From repository to live page without losing editability.
steps: Run RepoChan analysis on the target repository.
Create a persona with website visual fields and a foundation sheet.
Commission section prototype images through tracked orders.
Scaffold an Astro + Tailwind page project from the template.
Edit i18n JSON, theme tokens, assets, and components directly.

cta.heading: Make the mascot site a real project, not a screenshot.
cta.body: RepoChan's page output is designed for live agent edits: update copy, swap assets, tune components, and publish with GitHub Pages.

footer.tagline: Local-first creative production tracking for agent-generated mascot systems.
